content:
Anna: CI red on the canary build for runtime/serving — image push to staging registry failed right after the Dockerfile change that added a scratch stage. anyone seen this? :grimacing:
Matt: can you paste the push logs? quick guess: chown/squash in later stage messed tar headers before upload.
Anna: log from the push step:```text
2026-03-11T14:02:17Z buildkit: pushing layers...
PUT /v2/runtime/serving/blobs/uploads/abc123 416 Requested Range Not Satisfiable
remote: chunked upload failed: invalid range
error: failed to push to registry: unexpected status 416
```
Jess: hmm 416 is odd for a new layer. did the builder do any layer rewrite? which builder image?
Anna: buildx default on macstadium runners, build flags: `--squash` enabled in the PR, plus a chown in the final scratch stage.
Matt: can you try a rerun without `--squash`? squash can rewrite tar streams and some registries reject the chunked content ranges.
Julian: +1 to rerun. also check if our registry proxy recently bumped nginx that enforces `Content-Range` semantics differently. I saw a similar 416 with compressed layers last month.
Anna: starting a manual rerun now without squash — kicked off job: https://ci.internal/teams/infra/3291 — cc @Dev-CI
Dev-CI: rerun triggered: job 3291, buildkite link attached.
Jess: if rerun passes, still worth bisecting which Dockerfile change caused it. maybe the scratch stage chown changed tar header ordering.
Matt: quick local test suggestion: `docker buildx build --load --no-squash -t tmp:debug .` then `skopeo inspect docker-daemon:tmp:debug` and try `skopeo copy --dest-tls-verify=false docker-daemon:tmp:debug docker://staging.registry/runtime/serving` to emulate upload.
Anna: thanks, I'll run that if rerun fails. CI shows push step stuck at upload then failed immediately with 416.
Dev-CI: job 3291 finished: push step succeeded ✅ (no squash).
Anna: nice — so confirmed: squash + scratch chown combo triggers 416 in staging proxy. filing short follow-up issue for registry team and will revert squash in the PR for now.
Julian: can you include the minimal repro (Dockerfile + small binary) so registry team can reproduce? :eyes:
Anna: will do. creating issue and attaching logs + minimal Dockerfile. Marking this thread as triage->rerun success, keeping PR pinned until registry fix.
Jess: thanks for the quick rerun and confirmation. :thumbsup:
Anna: closing for now — will reopen if canary flakes again.
